product_family: QuickBooks Online with integrated AI features; includes Accounting Agent, Payments Agent, Customer Agent, Payroll Agent, Sales Tax Agent, and Business Tax Agent (beta). QuickBooks AI is not a standalone product but rather AI capabilities embedded within QuickBooks Online.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: QuickBooks maintains SOC reports that provide assurance over a service organization's internal controls, covering controls relevant to services provided including data processing, storage, transfer, and financial transactions.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: The QuickBooks Online Database is ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: QuickBooks Online is assessed annually for PCI DSS compliance and is listed on the Visa Registry of Global Service Providers.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: QuickBooks Online is not compliant with the HIPAA standards for privacy. If you are a health care professional, it is not recommended that you enter individually identifiable health information into the QuickBooks Online program.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Intuit restricts transferring customer data outside the European Economic Area unless obtaining prior written consent or implementing compliant safeguards such as standard contractual clauses adopted or approved by the European Commission.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (Cloud Security Alliance STAR)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification found on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: QuickBooks AI learns from customer business data to provide insights and recommendations. The DPA permits Intuit to de-identify and aggregate customer information to enhance its own products and services. Most AI agents cannot be permanently disabled; only the Accounting Agent and Payroll Agent offer opt-out options, and only for specific features (e.g., opt-out of AI-powered banking page).
privacy.data_region: Primary data storage in USA; EU data protected by Standard Contractual Clauses with restrictions on transfers outside EEA without consent. Data accessed by global teams and partners.

security.name: Data storage
security.value: Hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS); protected by multiple layers of network, storage, and physical access security

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Always-On Activity Log and Audit Trail features record every login and all changes to financial transactions

security.name: Data protection measures
security.value: DPA commits to appropriate technical and organizational measures including encryption, pseudonymization, system resilience, and regular security assessments

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Upon discovering breaches, Intuit notifies customers without undue delay and assists with remediation

security.name: Sub-processor management
security.value: Intuit obtains customer consent for subprocessor use, notifies of changes, imposes equivalent data protection obligations, and remains accountable

products.name: QuickBooks Online (Core)
products.data_scope: Financial transactions, invoices, receipts, bank connections, customer data, payroll (if using Payroll Agent)
products.notes: Main product with integrated AI features. Available as subscription. Supports multi-user access with role-based permissions.

products.name: Intuit Assist (AI-powered)
products.data_scope: Operates on customer financial and business data within QuickBooks Online
products.notes: AI agents include: Accounting Agent (receipt matching, categorization), Payments Agent, Customer Agent, Payroll Agent, Sales Tax Agent, and Business Tax Agent (beta). Limited opt-out options.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based (tiered: Simple Start, Essentials, Plus, Advanced)
compare.data_residency: Primary: USA; EU data protected by Standard Contractual Clauses; can restrict transfers outside EEA with consent

flags: AI training opt-out is not comprehensive: customer data is used to train AI models with limited opt-out options. Most AI agents cannot be disabled; only Accounting Agent and Payroll Agent offer partial opt-out.
HIPAA NOT supported: explicitly not recommended for healthcare providers handling protected health information.
Data training disclosure: While DPA permits de-identified and aggregated data use for product improvement, clear disclosure of customer data being used for AI model training could be more prominent.
ISO 42001 (AI governance) and CSA STAR certifications not held: no public evidence of AI-specific governance frameworks beyond general ISO 27001.
SOC 2 report access: some community discussions suggest difficulty obtaining current SOC 2 reports; reports cover historical periods (e.g., July 2021 to April 2022) and may lag current dates.
